title: [DKLLW24] integer and single-sigma Q8-HFPSS E2 patterns
purpose: A source-located review dataset for the two Q8-HFPSS E2 patterns computed by the 2-Bockstein spectral sequence. It records finite parametric families rather than pretending that the figures enumerate every class.

excluded: a proof that every displayed unit coefficient is canonically normalized
automatic admission into canonical HFPSS-Studio workspaces

sources.citation: Z. Duan, H. J. Kong, G. Li, Y. Lu, and G. Wang, RO(G)-graded homotopy fixed point spectral sequence for height 2 Morava E-theory.
locators: lines 619-649: Galois base change and W(F4) coefficients
lines 1048-1199: (*-sigma_i) 2-BSS, Tables 4-6, hidden h1/h2 extensions, Tate E2
lines 2482-2542: chart multiplication keys and page periodicities

sources.citation: I. Bobkova and P. G. Goerss, Topological resolutions in K(2)-local homotopy theory at the prime 2, J. Topol. 11 (2018), 918-957.
locators: Definition 2.1: bo-patterns are the image in K(1)-local homotopy
Remark 2.2: KO-patterns would be a more accurate name

coefficient_contexts.role: integral coefficient context reconstructed by the 2-BSS and completion
coefficient_contexts.warning: The Q8-HFPSS E2 page is not obtained by silently reducing every coefficient modulo 2. Unit ambiguity in W(F4) must remain explicit.

c3.module_statement: After inverting Delta=D^3, H^*(Q8,A)[D^-1] is free of rank 3 over H^*(G24,A)[Delta^-1] on 1,D,D^2.
c3.transport_policy: The three single-sigma pages have the same pattern after transporting the representation and basis. Exact labels may acquire a unit in F4^x or W(F4)^x; store the transported scalar rather than erasing it.

galois.normalizer_action: psi fixes sigma_i and swaps sigma_j with sigma_k; at group level (i,j,k) maps to (-i,-k,-j)
galois.coefficient_rule: psi is semilinear: every transported F4 coefficient is conjugated by a -> a^2, so zeta and zeta^2 are exchanged
galois.pattern_statement: The extended-stabilizer Frobenius action supplies filtered topological naturality for the psi transport; it is distinct from the cyclic C3 action omega.
galois.source_ref: Beaudry 2017 explicit supersingular-curve automorphisms, pp. 10-12; REU coefficientpuzzle.tex lines 29-43
galois.scope_warning: The psi transport swaps j and k with coefficient conjugation. It does not identify coefficients unchanged and does not by itself supply an i-j transposition.

store: basis used on each orbit representative
up-to-unit status when only a line is identified
forbid: replacing an unknown nonzero unit by 1 without a normalization certificate
identifying C3 transport with Galois conjugation

classification_semantics.not_a_disjoint_map_theoretic_partition: Every positive-filtration HFPSS E2 class, including a positive-filtration bo-pattern class, lies in the HFPSS-to-TateSS isomorphism range. The bo/tate-visible tags below instead record storage and proof provenance.
classification_semantics.bo_tag: Use for the v1-local KO-shaped d3 source/target/permanent families singled out by DKLLW24. Their cells are j-adic formal-power-series modules with j=v1^4D^-1; bo is not a low-filtration tag and visible tower height is not its definition.
classification_semantics.tate_visible_complement_tag: Use for the remaining positive-filtration families as proof-provenance metadata, not as the only families allowed to carry g repetition.
classification_semantics.short_h1_tower_warning: Slope-one edges are h1 multiplication. A tower may be drawn short because early differentials kill most of it; this does not turn the bo family into a low-filtration-only object.
classification_semantics.periodicity_correction: All applicable HFPSS families, including bo, use the forward g^sD^(8q) semiperiod with s>=0. Only a Tate comparison certificate upgrades g to a bidirectional translation.
classification_semantics.bg18_vs_chart_usage: BG18 defines bo-patterns on homotopy as the image in K(1)-local homotopy. DKLLW24 uses the same name at the spectral-sequence chart level for the KO-shaped d3 pattern and its specified survivors. The dataset records the DKLLW24 chart usage and keeps the BG18 definition as provenance.

hfpss_to_tatess.differential_correspondence: one-to-one for differentials whose source has nonnegative filtration
hfpss_to_tatess.tate_e2_construction: Invert k in the Q8-HFPSS E2 page and replace the zero line by the cokernel of the norm map.
hfpss_to_tatess.source_ref: DKLLW24 Lemma 2.6 and Remark 3.9; local lines 486-510 and 1195-1199

generators.not_valid_as: a pagewise HFPSS period after d5(D) becomes nonzero

generators.hfpss_role: forward semiperiod multiplication on every applicable family, including bo; it becomes bidirectional only through a positive-filtration Tate comparison certificate
generators.bo_role: g^s with s>=0 is part of the bo period family; the missing inverse at the lower boundary is recorded separately from family membership

all-hfpss-families.meaning: D^8 gives object identity; g groups forward translates into one semiperiod family without asserting g^-1 in HFPSS

tate-certified.validity: Both signs of the g exponent require a Tate comparison certificate and positive-filtration endpoints; bo membership is not an exclusion. D^8 is globally invertible in the HFPSS.

period_class_policy.representative_warning: The paper draws a full periodic range, not every representative. HFPSS-Studio should expand parametric families virtually and must not treat missing dots outside the printed window as zero.

differential_generators.parameters: q is any integer allowed by the localized expression

orientation_class.statement: Modulo 2, multiplication by u_sigma_i identifies the twisted E1 page abstractly with the integer E1 page; d1(u_sigma_i) records the failure of integral orientation.

e2_module_generators.source_note: The arXiv v3 TeX row at line 1167 prints (0,2), but |v1|=(2,0), |u_sigma_i|=(1-sigma_i,0), and Proposition 5.7 places this class at display bidegree (4,0). This dataset uses the degree-consistent (4,0) and leaves the discrepancy for review.

orbit_transport.policy: Transport the whole pattern through the C3 symmetry, with a recorded basis map and exact F4/W(F4) unit coefficient.

hidden_extensions.page_scope: integer Q8-HFPSS E2 reconstructed from the 2-BSS
hidden_extensions.transport: D^n at E2 only; transport beyond E2 requires survival of every factor
hidden_extensions.source_ref: DKLLW24 Remark 3.4; local lines 980-983; Bauer 2008 Eq. (7.13)

cycle_families.role: classes supporting or receiving the integer d3 pattern
differentials: d3(D^m g^s v1^(4l+2)h1^n)=D^m g^s v1^(4l)h1^(n+3), for l>=1 and n>=1
d3(D^m g^s v1^2h1^n)=D^m g^s h1^(n+3), for n>=1

cycle_families.role: integer v1-local permanent families after the d3 pattern
cycle_families.name_explanation: Together with the d3 source/target pairs these match many copies of pi_*KO. In BG18 the bo-pattern is the K(1)-local image; BG18 remarks that KO-pattern is the more accurate name.
cycle_families.source_ref: DKLLW24 Proposition 4.12 and Remark 4.13; BG18 Definition 2.1 and Remark 2.2

cycle_families.role: positive-filtration integer classes not selected by the bo classifiers above
cycle_families.classifier: filtration>0 and expression is outside bo-integer-d3-pairs and bo-integer-permanent
cycle_families.zero_line_warning: Filtration zero is only a surjective comparison to TateSS, so it is never admitted by this classifier without an extra norm-cokernel certificate.
cycle_families.source_ref: DKLLW24 Lemma 2.6, Remark 3.9, and chart convention lines 2541-2542

cycle_families.role: the v1-local single-sigma d3 family inherited from the integer module pattern

parameters.s: any integer allowed after Tate inversion; nonnegative on the HFPSS source module

cycle_families.distinction: The additional d3((h1+xv1)u_sigma_i)=2kv1^2u_sigma_i is recorded as a separate generator differential; it does not change the j-adic module classification of the bo towers.

cycle_families.role: single-sigma v1-local permanent families after the first d3 pattern

parameters.m: integer >= 0 in the proposition as printed

cycle_families.role: positive-filtration single-sigma classes outside the v1-local bo classifiers
cycle_families.classifier: filtration>0 and expression is outside bo-sigma-d3-pairs and bo-sigma-permanent
cycle_families.source_ref: DKLLW24 Lemma 2.6, Proposition 5.8, and chart convention lines 2541-2542

named_period_classes.identity_warning: sharing this id means one semiperiod family, not that g has a global HFPSS inverse

named_period_classes.equivalence: x~D^(8q)g^r x when a positive-filtration Tate comparison certificate covers both endpoints
non_equivalences: no g^-1 pullback through filtration zero without an additional theorem
no automatic extension to mixed RO(Q8) pages

module_kinds.j-adic-formal-power-series: F4[[j]], jF4[[j]], or a declared Witt/torsion analogue; one module glyph represents infinitely many j-powers
module_kinds.cell-resolved: read the concrete glyph/coefficient presentation before assigning one of the three algebraic kinds

chart_semantics.classification_warning: Neither filtration nor the visible height of an h1 tower determines module kind.
chart_semantics.source_ref: DKLLW24 Tables 10-11 and Remarks 6.1-6.2; local lines 2482-2525

source_discrepancies.description: Local main.tex line 918 truncates the displayed list of coefficient eigenvalues. The surrounding argument explicitly requires 1,zeta,zeta^2.
Table 5 source line 1167 prints (0,2) for v1^2u_sigma_i, while generator degrees and Proposition 5.7 give display bidegree (4,0). The dataset records (4,0).

review_checks.question: Do the chosen sigma_j and sigma_k bases make every transported zeta coefficient explicit without identifying C3 with Gal(F4/F2)?
Should the extra sigma_i d3 on (h1+xv1)u_sigma_i remain in the Tate-visible complement, or should the project adopt a broader chart-level bo label?
Should source labels Z/2^n be normalized in Studio as W(F4)/2^n modules, while preserving the literal table labels?
For each future g-translation, has Studio checked that both endpoints stay in the positive-filtration HFPSS-to-TateSS isomorphism range?
Are missing printed representatives treated as virtual translates rather than absent classes?
